_comment: Masteries overrides, layers 2-4 of DESIGN §1.2 (export-fix < wiki-fact < correction), one record per line. Read by tools/build-masteries.js.

target: the DDragon cell id ("4241") for DDragon-era patches, "<Tree>/<name>" for wiki-era ones. field: name | desc | rankInfo | rankInfo2 | perlevel | ranks | rankDesc | rankDesc[<rank index>]. from/to: inclusive range of listed patches.
The build fails when a target is missing in a listed patch of the range, or when the override changes nothing there (stale). Applied ids are written into the header of each generated file.

Tooltip policy (D3): the client's own text, mistakes included (V3.14 Tenacious / Legendary Guardian swap, V5.22 Perseverance 'below 20%', Fresh Blood 6 s, the V5.24-V6.2 Bond of Stone text without its 5% threshold). Only export defects (what the live client did not show) are fixed here; mechanics the text leaves out go into the listing's change notes.

overrides.reason: DDragon 3.14.x exports the name as 'Runic Shield'; the client, the wiki and the patch notes call it Runic Blessing, and DDragon 3.15 fixed the export
DDragon 3.14.x exports 'Veteran Scars'; the client and the wiki say Veteran's Scars, fixed in DDragon 3.15
Every 2014-tree DDragon build exports the name with a trailing space ('Perseverance ')
DDragon 5.22.1-5.24.1 exports the untranslated key 'game_mastery_displayname_6112' as the name of Sorcery (6114); 5.24.2 restores it

The S1 Ardor template has two '#' (ability power and attack speed) but only one value list, so the tooltip showed '+#% Attack Speed' (baseline defect found in P0-A). The wiki gives the same 1.33/2.66/4% for both stats

The client printed the level-18 totals of Deadliness as whole numbers (3 / 6 / 9 / 12: the per-level values are 1/6, 1/3, 1/2, 2/3, shown rounded as 0.17 / 0.33 / 0.5 / 0.67); the template's derived total (rankInfo x 18, one decimal) gave 3.1 / 5.9 / 9 / 12.1. With mo-007 the second '#' takes the client's totals instead of the derived ones
Deadliness level-18 totals as the client showed them ('+3 Attack Damage at level 18 (0.17 Attack Damage per level)' ... '+12 ...'); see mo-006

overrides.value:
Improves the following Summoner Spells:

|Teleport:| Reduces cast time by # second
|Revive:| Grants (200 + 20 per level) bonus Health on Revive for 2 minutes
|Flash:| Reduces cooldown by 15 seconds
|Clarity:| Increases Mana restored by 25%
|Clairvoyance:| Grants additional vision of enemy units revealed
overrides.reason: From V3.12 on the client text names the Revive bonus Health ('Revive: Grants (200 + 20 per level) bonus Health for 2 minutes upon reviving', DDragon 3.12.x-3.13.24; 3.6.14-3.11.x have no figure). The S3 template keeps its wording and gains the figure (D3: the client text of the patch). V3.12 is not listed, so V3.13 is the first listed patch with it
